column1: # How documents of older IDML versions are read into the current model.
# Every schema item that an older version has and the current one has not, or
# has differently, needs a rule. idml-codegen fails if one is missing (and
# suggests it) or not needed, then turns the rules into edits the reader makes
# to older documents (src/model/upgrades.rs) and shows them in the reports.
# item  a schema item, as in schema-history.tsv
# rule  drop             leave it out; the reader warns. Dropping a definition
#                        drops its element everywhere; dropping an element
#       wrap <A>/<B>     put the element into new <A><B> elements
#       default "v"      an attribute that became required: v where missing
#       value "v"        an enumeration value: read as v instead
#       keep             every old value is still valid
